newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Everbright hopes to seal Theme talks soon.
newsitem.headline: Everbright hopes to seal Theme talks soon.

text.p: China Everbright group chairman Zhu Xiao Hua said on Thursday he hoped to conclude talks soon to buy a stake in Hong Kong fashion retailer Theme International Holdings Ltd.
"Hopefully we can see some results this month or next," Zhu told Reuters.
Zhu was speaking at the opening ceremony of China Everbright's Singapore regional headquarters.
Theme and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd are in negotiations which could lead to Everbright-IHD taking a 20 percent stake in Theme and Theme taking over an Everbright unit.
China Everbright Holdings has a 51 percent stake in Hong Kong-listed Everbright-IHD.

If the deals went through, Everbright-IHD would subscribe for new Theme shares. In turn, Theme would get from Everbright-IHD, a majority equity interest in Emporium Holdings (Singapore) Ltd and receive cash of about HK$50 million.
Everbright-IHD has a 99 percent voting rights in Emporium.
